mentions.name: Sundown
mentions.description: A shared calendar app for couples built as a distraction-free progressive web app (PWA) for coordinating schedules together. Built with Django, HTMX, and SQLite, hosted on a Hetzner VPS.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a shared calendar for couples. I attempt to build a distraction-free experience inside the app and to keep it as a PWA.
